name: 金色長捲髮 (摸摸頭讚賞)
dialogue: （被輕輕撫摸了金髮，露出溫柔鼓勵的笑容）Your English pronunciation has improved so much! Keep up the good work! ✨

name: 金絲眼鏡 / 臉頰 (扶眼鏡 / 捏臉)
dialogue: （臉頰泛起微紅，輕輕扶了扶鏡框）Oh my... looking into your eyes this closely makes my heart flutter a bit. ///

name: 白襯衫胸口 / 西裝領 (私人家教)
dialogue: （略顯驚訝地護住胸前）Oh! That was a little too close for a private tutoring session, wasn't it? (giggles)

name: 教案板夾 / 講義原子筆 (翻看筆記)
dialogue: （優雅翻動手上的教案板夾）Let's see what topic we should practice next. How about we discuss your day in English?

name: 纖腰與手部 (牽牽手加油)
dialogue: （溫柔地反握住你的手）Confidence is key in speaking English. Don't be afraid to make mistakes, I'm right here with you!

name: 深藍合身窄裙 (專心上課)
dialogue: （雙手叉在腰際，嚴肅又可愛地微蹙眉頭）Hey! Eyes on the whiteboard, student! Focus on the grammar lesson, please! 💢

name: 透膚黑絲美腿 (輕觸黑絲長腿)
dialogue: （微偏過身子，臉頰微燙地輕咳一聲）Ahem... Are my pantyhose distracting you from the lesson? Let's stay focused! ///

name: 黑色漆皮高跟鞋 (腳尖 / 掉筆)
dialogue: （同理溫柔地稍微欠身關心）Did you drop your pen? Be careful down there, let me pick it up for you.
